metadata.name: GDP (Current US$)
metadata.short_description: Gross domestic product at purchaser's prices in current US dollars.
metadata.source: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

metadata.name: GDP per Capita (Current US$)
metadata.short_description: Gross domestic product divided by midyear population in current US dollars.
metadata.source: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

metadata.name: GDP Growth (Annual %)
metadata.short_description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.
metadata.source: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

metadata.name: Inflation, Consumer Prices (Annual %)
metadata.short_description: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of acquiring a basket of goods and services.
metadata.source: International Monetary Fund, International Financial Statistics and data files.

metadata.name: Exports of Goods and Services (% of GDP)
metadata.short_description: Value of all goods and other market services provided to the rest of the world as % of GDP.
metadata.source: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

metadata.name: Imports of Goods and Services (% of GDP)
metadata.short_description: Value of all goods and other market services received from the rest of the world as % of GDP.
metadata.source: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

metadata.name: Foreign Direct Investment, Net Inflows (% of GDP)
metadata.short_description: Net inflows of investment to acquire a lasting management interest in an enterprise.
metadata.source: International Monetary Fund, Balance of Payments database.

metadata.name: Total Population
metadata.short_description: Total population counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
metadata.source: United Nations Population Division. World Population Prospects.

metadata.name: Population Growth (Annual %)
metadata.short_description: Exponential annual rate of population growth from midyear t-1 to midyear t.
metadata.source: United Nations Population Division. World Population Prospects.

metadata.name: Urban Population (% of Total)
metadata.short_description: Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices.
metadata.source: United Nations Population Division. World Urbanization Prospects.

metadata.name: Life Expectancy at Birth (Years)
metadata.short_description: Number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality were to stay the same.
metadata.source: United Nations Population Division and World Bank Group.

metadata.name: Birth Rate, Crude (per 1,000 People)
metadata.short_description: Crude birth rate indicates the number of live births occurring during the year per 1,000 midyear population.
metadata.source: United Nations Population Division. World Population Prospects.

metadata.name: Death Rate, Crude (per 1,000 People)
metadata.short_description: Crude death rate indicates the number of deaths occurring during the year per 1,000 midyear population.
metadata.source: United Nations Population Division. World Population Prospects.

metadata.name: Unemployment Rate (% of Labor Force)
metadata.short_description: Share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
metadata.source: International Labour Organization, ILOSTAT database.

metadata.name: Labor Force Participation Rate (% of Ages 15+)
metadata.short_description: Proportion of the population ages 15 and older that engages actively in the labor market.
metadata.source: International Labour Organization, ILOSTAT database.

metadata.name: Employment to Population Ratio (% Ages 15+)
metadata.short_description: Proportion of a country's population aged 15 and older that is employed.
metadata.source: International Labour Organization, ILOSTAT database.

metadata.name: School Enrollment, Primary (% Gross)
metadata.short_description: Total enrollment in primary education, regardless of age, expressed as percentage of the official primary education age population.
metadata.source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics.

metadata.name: School Enrollment, Secondary (% Gross)
metadata.short_description: Total enrollment in secondary education, regardless of age, expressed as percentage of the official secondary education age population.
metadata.source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics.

metadata.name: Government Expenditure on Education (% of GDP)
metadata.short_description: General government expenditure on education (current, capital, and transfers) expressed as percentage of GDP.
metadata.source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics.

metadata.name: Adult Literacy Rate (% Ages 15+)
metadata.short_description: Percentage of people aged 15 and above who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement.
metadata.source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics.

metadata.name: Individuals Using the Internet (% of Population)
metadata.short_description: Percentage of individuals who used the Internet from any location in the last 3 months via any device.
metadata.source: International Telecommunication Union (ITU) World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators.

metadata.name: Mobile Cellular Subscriptions (per 100 People)
metadata.short_description: Subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service providing access to the PSTN using cellular technology.
metadata.source: International Telecommunication Union (ITU).

metadata.name: Secure Internet Servers (per Million People)
metadata.short_description: Number of publicly accessible secure Internet servers using SSL/TLS encryption per million people.
metadata.source: Netcraft and World Bank population estimates.

metadata.name: Forest Area (% of Land Area)
metadata.short_description: Land spanning more than 0.5 hectares with trees higher than 5 meters and a canopy cover of more than 10 percent.
metadata.source: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Global Forest Resources Assessment.

metadata.name: Renewable Electricity Output (% of Total Electricity)
metadata.short_description: Share of electricity generated by renewable power plants including hydropower, solar, wind, and bioenergy.
metadata.source: IEA World Energy Statistics and Balances.

metadata.name: Renewable Energy Consumption (% of Total Final Energy)
metadata.short_description: Share of renewable energy in total final energy consumption.
metadata.source: World Bank, Sustainable Energy for All (SE4ALL) database.

metadata.name: Energy Use (kg of Oil Equivalent per Capita)
metadata.short_description: Use of primary energy before transformation to other end-use fuels.
metadata.source: International Energy Agency (IEA).

metadata.name: Access to Electricity (% of Population)
metadata.short_description: Percentage of people in a country with access to electricity from grid or off-grid sources.
metadata.source: World Bank, Sustainable Energy for All (SE4ALL) database.

metadata.name: Electric Power Consumption (kWh per Capita)
metadata.short_description: Electric power consumption measures the production of power plants and combined heat and power plants less transmission, distribution, and transformation losses.
metadata.source: International Energy Agency (IEA).

metadata.name: Agricultural Land (% of Land Area)
metadata.short_description: Share of land area that is arable, under permanent crops, and under permanent pastures.
metadata.source: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).
